text: 昼出耘田夜绩麻，村庄儿女各当家
pinyin: zhòu chū yún tián yè jì má, cūn zhuāng ér nǚ gè dāng jiā
literal: day · go out · weed · fields · night · spin · hemp, village · sons · daughters · each · run · household
natural: By day they weed the fields and by night they spin hemp; the village's sons and daughters each manage their own tasks

meaning.en: Describes the whole village, young and old, busy with farm and household work in summer.
meaning.zh: 描写夏日农村男女老少各司其职、辛勤劳作的景象。

equivalents: everyone pulling their weight on the farm

examples.zh: 这首诗里的“昼出耘田夜绩麻，村庄儿女各当家”，写出了农家的勤劳。
examples.en: The line in this poem shows how hard farm families work.

examples.zh: 课本上有“昼出耘田夜绩麻，村庄儿女各当家”，描绘了乡村夏日。
examples.en: The textbook has this line, painting a rural summer.

story.en: From Fan Chengda's sixty poems on the pastoral life of the four seasons; this one is from the summer set (夏日田园杂兴).
story.zh: 范成大《四时田园杂兴》组诗之一，此首属“夏日田园杂兴”。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 梅子金黄杏子肥，麦花雪白菜花稀
pinyin: méi zǐ jīn huáng xìng zǐ féi, mài huā xuě bái cài huā xī
literal: plums · golden · yellow · apricots · plump, wheat · flowers · snow · white · rape · flowers · sparse
natural: The plums are golden and the apricots plump; the wheat flowers are snow-white and the rape flowers sparse

meaning.en: A picture of early summer in the countryside.
meaning.zh: 描写初夏农村的田园景色。

equivalents: early summer on the farm

examples.zh: 初夏回到老家，满眼都是“梅子金黄杏子肥，麦花雪白菜花稀”的景象。
examples.en: Returning to my hometown in early summer I saw just this scene.

examples.zh: 他用“梅子金黄杏子肥，麦花雪白菜花稀”教孩子认识季节。
examples.en: He used this line to teach his child about the seasons.

story.en: From the summer group of Fan Chengda's pastoral poems, which also gives the line about weeding by day and spinning by night.
story.zh: 出自范成大《夏日田园杂兴》，与“昼出耘田夜绩麻”同属一组。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 应怜屐齿印苍苔，小扣柴扉久不开
pinyin: yīng lián jī chǐ yìn cāng tái, xiǎo kòu chái fēi jiǔ bù kāi
literal: perhaps · pity · clog · teeth · print · green · moss, lightly · knock · brushwood · door · long · not · open
natural: Perhaps the owner pities his moss from my clog-prints; I knock lightly at the wicker gate and it stays long shut

meaning.en: A visit that finds the door closed; read together with the next line, 'a spray of red apricot blossom reaches over the wall'.
meaning.zh: 寻访主人不遇、柴门久闭的情景；与下句“春色满园关不住，一枝红杏出墙来”相连。

equivalents: a visit to an empty house

examples.zh: 敲了半天门没人应，他想起“应怜屐齿印苍苔，小扣柴扉久不开”。
examples.en: No one answered his knock, and he thought of this line.

examples.zh: 这句“应怜屐齿印苍苔，小扣柴扉久不开”引出了后面的千古名句。
examples.en: This line leads into the famous couplet that follows.

story.en: Ye Shaoweng went to visit a garden but found the gate closed; he was consoled by an apricot branch peeping over the wall.
story.zh: 叶绍翁游园不遇，柴门紧闭，却见一枝红杏探出墙头，聊以自慰。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 乡村四月闲人少，才了蚕桑又插田
pinyin: xiāng cūn sì yuè xián rén shǎo, cái liǎo cán sāng yòu chā tián
literal: countryside · fourth · month · idle · people · few, just · finish · silkworms · mulberry · again · plant · fields
natural: In the fourth month in the countryside few people are idle; as soon as silkworm-rearing is done they plant out the rice

meaning.en: Villagers are busy with one farm job after another in late spring.
meaning.zh: 农历四月农家忙碌，刚忙完养蚕，又要插秧。

equivalents: one job after another on the farm

examples.zh: 夏忙时节，农村正是“乡村四月闲人少，才了蚕桑又插田”。
examples.en: In the busy farming season the countryside is just like this line.

examples.zh: 他用“乡村四月闲人少，才了蚕桑又插田”来形容毕业季的忙碌。
examples.en: He used this line to describe the busy graduation season.

story.en: Weng Juan, one of the 'Four Lings of Yongjia', paints the green fields of April and the village's busy work.
story.zh: 永嘉四灵之一翁卷所作，写农历四月乡村景色与农事繁忙。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 黄梅时节家家雨，青草池塘处处蛙
pinyin: huáng méi shí jié jiā jiā yǔ, qīng cǎo chí táng chù chù wā
literal: yellow · plum · season · every · house · rain, green · grass · pond · everywhere · frogs
natural: In the plum-rain season it rains at every house; by the grassy ponds there are frogs everywhere

meaning.en: Evokes the damp, lively early-summer plum-rain season in southern China.
meaning.zh: 描绘江南梅雨季节雨水不断、蛙声四起的景象。

equivalents: the plum rains and croaking frogs of early summer

examples.zh: 江南的梅雨季，正是“黄梅时节家家雨，青草池塘处处蛙”。
examples.en: The plum-rain season in Jiangnan is just this line.

examples.zh: 窗外下着雨，蛙声一片，让人想起“黄梅时节家家雨，青草池塘处处蛙”。
examples.en: Rain outside and frogs croaking everywhere remind me of this line.

story.en: Zhao Shixiu waited late at night for a guest who never came, idly tapping a chess piece and watching the lamp-wick burn down.
story.zh: 赵师秀夜里约客不至，闲敲棋子，落下灯花。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 暖风熏得游人醉，直把杭州作汴州
pinyin: nuǎn fēng xūn dé yóu rén zuì, zhí bǎ háng zhōu zuò biàn zhōu
literal: warm · wind · steam · makes · tourists · drunk, simply · take · Hangzhou · as · Bianzhou
natural: The warm breeze intoxicates the pleasure-seekers, who treat Hangzhou as if it were still the old capital Bianzhou

meaning.en: A satire of complacent people who enjoy pleasure and forget a national humiliation.
meaning.zh: 讽刺醉生梦死、苟且偷安，忘却国耻的权贵。

equivalents: fiddling while Rome burns
blind to the national disgrace

examples.zh: 有人评论说，这种享乐风气让人想起“暖风熏得游人醉，直把杭州作汴州”。
examples.en: One commentator said this culture of pleasure recalls this line.

examples.zh: 历史课上老师解读了“暖风熏得游人醉，直把杭州作汴州”的讽刺意味。
examples.en: In history class the teacher explained the irony in this line.

story.en: Lin Sheng wrote it on the wall of an inn at Lin'an (Hangzhou), the Southern Song capital, attacking the court for forgetting the lost northern capital Bianliang.
story.zh: 林升题于临安旅店墙壁，讽刺南宋权贵偏安杭州、纵情享乐，忘了沦陷的汴京。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 疏影横斜水清浅，暗香浮动月黄昏
pinyin: shū yǐng héng xié shuǐ qīng qiǎn, àn xiāng fú dòng yuè huáng hūn
literal: sparse · shadows · slanting · water · clear · shallow, hidden · fragrance · drifting · moon · dusk
natural: Sparse shadows slant over clear shallow water; a hidden fragrance drifts under the dusk moon

meaning.en: The most celebrated description of plum blossom, with elegant shadows and scent.
meaning.zh: 咏梅名句，写梅花疏影清雅、暗香浮动的神韵。

equivalents: plum blossom at its most elegant

examples.zh: 冬日月夜，院里的梅花正是“疏影横斜水清浅，暗香浮动月黄昏”。
examples.en: On a winter moonlit night the plum blossoms in the yard are just this line.

examples.zh: 他在咏梅诗里化用了“疏影横斜水清浅，暗香浮动月黄昏”的意境。
examples.en: In his poem on plum blossom he drew on the mood of "sparse shadows slant across the clear shallow water; hidden fragrance drifts under the dusk moon."

story.en: Lin Bu, the recluse who 'married plum trees and kept cranes as sons', wrote it on the plum blossoms of his West Lake hermitage.
story.zh: 林逋隐居西湖孤山，“梅妻鹤子”，此为他咏园中梅花的名作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 遍身罗绮者，不是养蚕人
pinyin: biàn shēn luó qǐ zhě, bù shì yǎng cán rén
literal: all · body · silk · damask · ones, not · are · raise · silkworm · people
natural: Those dressed head to toe in silks are not the ones who raise the silkworms

meaning.en: A criticism of social unfairness: those who produce wealth do not enjoy it.
meaning.zh: 批评社会不公：创造财富的劳动者自己却穿不起好衣服。

equivalents: those who make it don't enjoy it

examples.zh: 看到外卖员冒雨送餐，他想起“遍身罗绮者，不是养蚕人”。
examples.en: Seeing a delivery rider in the rain, he thought of this line.

examples.zh: 这首《蚕妇》以“遍身罗绮者，不是养蚕人”收尾，发人深省。
examples.en: The poem 'The Silkworm Woman' ends on this line and makes one think.

story.en: Zhang Yu's poem tells of a silkworm woman who goes to town and returns in tears: the clothed ones are not the silk-makers.
story.zh: 张俞《蚕妇》：蚕妇进城归来泪满巾，因为穿着绫罗者并非养蚕之人。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 山气日夕佳，飞鸟相与还
pinyin: shān qì rì xī jiā, fēi niǎo xiāng yǔ huán
literal: mountain · air · sun · dusk · fine, flying · birds · together · return
natural: The mountain air is lovely at dusk, and the flying birds return together

meaning.en: A peaceful dusk scene of mountain air and homing birds.
meaning.zh: 写傍晚山间景色优美、飞鸟结伴归巢的宁静。

equivalents: peaceful dusk and homeward birds

examples.zh: 傍晚的山林，让人想起“山气日夕佳，飞鸟相与还”。
examples.en: The mountain forest at dusk calls to mind this line.

examples.zh: 这句“山气日夕佳，飞鸟相与还”体现了田园生活的恬淡。
examples.en: This line shows the tranquillity of country life.

story.en: From Tao Yuanming's Drinking Wine, no. 5, which also has 'picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence, I see the southern hills at leisure'.
story.zh: 出自陶渊明《饮酒》其五，同诗另有“采菊东篱下，悠然见南山”。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 悟已往之不谏，知来者之可追。实迷途其未远，觉今是而昨非
pinyin: wù yǐ wǎng zhī bù jiàn, zhī lái zhě zhī kě zhuī, shí mí tú qí wèi yuǎn, jué jīn shì ér zuó fēi
literal: realise · past · of · cannot · be remonstrated, know · coming · ones · of · can · be pursued, truly · lost · road · it · not yet · far, perceive · today · right · and · yesterday · wrong
natural: I see that the past cannot be mended but the future can still be pursued; I have not strayed far down the wrong road, and I realise that today is right and yesterday wrong

meaning.en: It is not too late to correct a mistake: face the future and change course.
meaning.zh: 过去的错误已无法挽回，未来还可补救，迷路未远，应及时醒悟改正。

equivalents: it's never too late to change course
better late than never

examples.zh: 他戒掉赌博后，深感“悟已往之不谏，知来者之可追。实迷途其未远，觉今是而昨非”。
examples.en: After giving up gambling he felt this line deeply.

examples.zh: “悟已往之不谏，知来者之可追。实迷途其未远，觉今是而昨非”常用来鼓励人及时回头。
examples.en: This line is often used to urge someone to turn back in time.

story.en: Tao Yuanming wrote it in 405 on resigning as magistrate of Pengze after 83 days, to return to his farm and live a free life.
story.zh: 陶渊明辞去彭泽令（任职仅八十余日）归隐田园时作，表达对出仕的悔悟和对自由生活的向往。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 云无心以出岫，鸟倦飞而知还
pinyin: yún wú xīn yǐ chū xiù, niǎo juàn fēi ér zhī huán
literal: clouds · without · intent · to · leave · peaks, birds · tired · of flying · and · know · to return
natural: Clouds drift from the peaks without intent; birds tired of flying know to return home

meaning.en: Like carefree clouds and weary birds, one drifts freely and eventually returns home.
meaning.zh: 云朵无心地飘出山峰，鸟儿飞倦了知道回巢；喻悠然自得，也喻倦游思归。

equivalents: drifting free, and homeward bound at last

examples.zh: 在外漂泊多年，他终于“云无心以出岫，鸟倦飞而知还”，回到了老家。
examples.en: After years away, he finally returned home like the weary bird.

examples.zh: 这句“云无心以出岫，鸟倦飞而知还”常被用来表达归隐之志。
examples.en: This line is often used to express a wish for a quiet retreat.

story.en: From the same prose-poem: Tao Yuanming compares himself to clouds and birds on his way back to the countryside.
story.zh: 同篇《归去来兮辞》：以无心之云、倦飞之鸟自比，写归田之乐。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 好读书，不求甚解；每有会意，便欣然忘食
pinyin: hào dú shū, bù qiú shèn jiě, měi yǒu huì yì, biàn xīn rán wàng shí
literal: love · read · books, not · seek · deep · explanation, whenever · have · insight, then · gladly · forget · food
natural: He loves reading but does not insist on pinning down every detail; whenever he grasps the sense, he happily forgets to eat

meaning.en: Read for pleasure and understanding, without pedantry; today 不求甚解 is also used negatively for superficial study.
meaning.zh: 读书重在领会大意、乐在其中，不拘泥于字句；今天“不求甚解”也常带贬义，指学习浮于表面。

equivalents: read for the joy of it
get the gist and enjoy it

examples.zh: 他读书“好读书，不求甚解；每有会意，便欣然忘食”，所以读得很快乐。
examples.en: He reads for the gist and with delight, so he reads happily.

examples.zh: 陶渊明“好读书，不求甚解；每有会意，便欣然忘食”的读书态度很值得借鉴。
examples.en: Tao Yuanming's attitude of reading in this way is worth learning from.

story.en: Tao Yuanming's self-portrait as 'Mr Five Willows' who loves reading and drink and is indifferent to wealth.
story.zh: 陶渊明以“五柳先生”自况：嗜书好饮，淡泊名利。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 不戚戚于贫贱，不汲汲于富贵
pinyin: bù qī qī yú pín jiàn, bù jí jí yú fù guì
literal: not · grieve · over · poor · lowly, not · strive · for · rich · noble
natural: He neither grieves over poverty and low status nor chases wealth and rank

meaning.en: Be content in humble circumstances and do not hunger for riches.
meaning.zh: 不为贫贱而忧愁，也不急于追求富贵，淡泊自守。

equivalents: indifferent to rich and poor alike
be above wealth and poverty

examples.zh: 他一生“不戚戚于贫贱，不汲汲于富贵”，只愿安心做学问。
examples.en: All his life he was neither downcast by poverty nor eager for wealth, wishing only to study.

examples.zh: 父亲常用“不戚戚于贫贱，不汲汲于富贵”教导我们。
examples.en: My father often taught us with this line.

story.en: In the same self-portrait: Mr Five Willows is not troubled by poverty and does not covet rank.
story.zh: 同篇《五柳先生传》：五柳先生不为贫贱忧，不慕富贵。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 黄发垂髫，并怡然自乐
pinyin: huáng fà chuí tiáo, bìng yí rán zì lè
literal: yellow · hair · hanging · tufts, all · cheerful · self · happy
natural: Old people and children alike are cheerful and content

meaning.en: Everyone, old and young, lives peacefully and happily; used to describe an ideal society.
meaning.zh: 老人和孩子都安乐自得，形容理想社会中人人和乐的景象。

equivalents: young and old alike living contentedly

examples.zh: 社区运动会上，“黄发垂髫，并怡然自乐”，场面温馨。
examples.en: At the neighbourhood sports day old and young are all cheerful, a warm scene.

examples.zh: 他用“黄发垂髫，并怡然自乐”描写理想中的家园。
examples.en: He used this line to describe an ideal homeland.

story.en: From the Peach Blossom Spring: a fisherman discovers a hidden village whose people live at peace, untouched by war and taxes.
story.zh: 出自《桃花源记》：渔人误入桃花源，见其中人民安居乐业，不受战乱与赋税之苦。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 芳草鲜美，落英缤纷
pinyin: fāng cǎo xiān měi, luò yīng bīn fēn
literal: fragrant · grass · fresh · lovely, falling · petals · profuse · swirling
natural: Fragrant grass is fresh and lovely, and fallen petals whirl in profusion

meaning.en: Describes a beautiful flower-strewn spring landscape.
meaning.zh: 形容春日草木芬芳、落花缤纷的美景。

equivalents: fresh grass and a flurry of petals

examples.zh: 公园里春意盎然，真是“芳草鲜美，落英缤纷”。
examples.en: Spring fills the park, truly this line.

examples.zh: 摄影展用“芳草鲜美，落英缤纷”作主题。
examples.en: The photo exhibition took this line as its theme.

story.en: The fisherman walks along a stream lined with peach trees for a hundred paces; this is the scene he meets before reaching the hidden village.
story.zh: 出自《桃花源记》：渔人沿溪行，忽逢桃花林，夹岸数百步，中无杂树，芳草鲜美，落英缤纷。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 精卫衔微木，将以填沧海。刑天舞干戚，猛志固常在
pinyin: jīng wèi xián wēi mù, jiāng yǐ tián cāng hǎi, xíng tiān wǔ gān qī, měng zhì gù cháng zài
literal: Jingwei · carry · tiny · twigs, intend · to · fill · blue · sea, Xingtian · wield · shield · axe, fierce · will · still · always · remain
natural: Jingwei carries tiny twigs, meaning to fill the sea; Xingtian brandishes shield and axe, his fierce will still undying

meaning.en: Praises the unyielding spirit of mythical figures who fight on after defeat.
meaning.zh: 赞颂神话人物屡败屡战、矢志不渝的坚强意志。

equivalents: never give up the fight
an indomitable will

examples.zh: 面对困难，他用“精卫衔微木，将以填沧海。刑天舞干戚，猛志固常在”激励自己。
examples.en: Facing hardship he encouraged himself with this poem.

examples.zh: 这首诗歌颂了“精卫衔微木，将以填沧海。刑天舞干戚，猛志固常在”的精神。
examples.en: The poem sings the spirit of this couplet.

story.en: Tao Yuanming's poem on the Classic of Mountains and Seas: the bird Jingwei, drowned in the sea, fills it with twigs; Xingtian, beheaded, fights on with nipples for eyes.
story.zh: 陶渊明读《山海经》诗：精卫溺死东海，化鸟衔木填海；刑天被斩首，仍以乳为目、以脐为口，挥舞干戚。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.

text: 日月之行，若出其中；星汉灿烂，若出其里
pinyin: rì yuè zhī xíng, ruò chū qí zhōng, xīng hàn càn làn, ruò chū qí lǐ
literal: sun · moon · of · course, as if · emerge · its · midst, star · river · bright · brilliant, as if · emerge · its · inside
natural: The sun and moon seem to rise from within it; the Milky Way's brilliance seems to come from inside it

meaning.en: A grand image of the sea's vastness, holding sun, moon and stars.
meaning.zh: 写大海浩瀚无边，日月星辰仿佛都从中升起。

equivalents: a sea vast enough to hold the sun, moon and stars

examples.zh: 站在海边，他背诵起“日月之行，若出其中；星汉灿烂，若出其里”。
examples.en: Standing by the sea he began reciting this line.

examples.zh: 这句“日月之行，若出其中；星汉灿烂，若出其里”体现了曹操开阔的胸襟。
examples.en: This line reflects Cao Cao's broad mind.

story.en: Cao Cao wrote it in 207 after defeating the Wuhuan, looking at the sea from Mount Jieshi.
story.zh: 曹操于建安十二年北征乌桓得胜归来，登碣石山观海而作。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 山不厌高，海不厌深。周公吐哺，天下归心
pinyin: shān bù yàn gāo, hǎi bù yàn shēn, zhōu gōng tǔ bǔ, tiān xià guī xīn
literal: mountain · not · tire of · high, sea · not · tire of · deep, Duke of Zhou · spit out · food, world · turns · heart
natural: The mountain is never too high and the sea never too deep; the Duke of Zhou spat out his food to greet visitors, and the world gave him its heart

meaning.en: A ruler should welcome talent without limit, as the mountain and sea accept all, to win the people's allegiance.
meaning.zh: 山海不嫌高深，比喻君主应礼贤下士、广纳人才，才能赢得天下归心。

equivalents: a leader who welcomes talent wins hearts

examples.zh: 企业家引用“山不厌高，海不厌深。周公吐哺，天下归心”，表示求贤若渴。
examples.en: The entrepreneur quoted this line to show he is thirsty for talent.

examples.zh: 这首诗末尾的“山不厌高，海不厌深。周公吐哺，天下归心”，表现了曹操的政治抱负。
examples.en: The end of the poem shows Cao Cao's political ambition.

story.en: Cao Cao's Short Song ends with a hope to attract talent like the Duke of Zhou, who was said to spit out food mid-meal to receive visitors.
story.zh: 曹操《短歌行》结尾，用周公吐哺典故，表达求贤若渴、一统天下的抱负。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 捐躯赴国难，视死忽如归
pinyin: juān qū fù guó nàn, shì sǐ hū rú guī
literal: give up · body · go to · country's · peril, regard · death · as if · like · going home
natural: Give up one's life to meet the country's crisis, and treat death as lightly as returning home

meaning.en: Willingness to die for one's country without fear.
meaning.zh: 为国家危难献出生命，视死如归。

equivalents: to die for one's country without fear

examples.zh: 烈士墓前，同学们齐声朗诵“捐躯赴国难，视死忽如归”。
examples.en: At the martyrs' cemetery the students recited this line in unison.

examples.zh: 消防员的事迹，正是“捐躯赴国难，视死忽如归”的体现。
examples.en: The firefighter's deeds embody this line.

story.en: Cao Zhi's Ballad of the White Horse portrays a young frontier warrior who dedicates himself to defending the border.
story.zh: 曹植《白马篇》塑造了一位报国杀敌的游侠少年形象。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 翩若惊鸿，婉若游龙
pinyin: piān ruò jīng hóng, wǎn ruò yóu lóng
literal: light · like · startled · swan, supple · like · swimming · dragon
natural: Light as a startled swan, supple as a swimming dragon

meaning.en: Describes an elegant, graceful figure or movement.
meaning.zh: 形容体态轻盈优美、舞姿或身姿婉转灵动。

equivalents: graceful as a swan and supple as a dragon

examples.zh: 舞蹈演员的身姿“翩若惊鸿，婉若游龙”。
examples.en: The dancer's figure is as light as a startled swan and supple as a dragon.

examples.zh: 评论文章用“翩若惊鸿，婉若游龙”形容这位滑冰选手。
examples.en: The review used this line to describe the skater.

story.en: In Cao Zhi's Ode to the Goddess of the Luo River, he describes the beautiful goddess he meets by the river; the line is among the most quoted portrayals of grace.
story.zh: 曹植《洛神赋》描写洛水女神的仪态，此二句是形容轻盈优美的经典用语。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 盖文章，经国之大业，不朽之盛事
pinyin: gài wén zhāng, jīng guó zhī dà yè, bù xiǔ zhī shèng shì
literal: indeed · writing, govern · state · of · great · enterprise, not · decay · of · grand · matter
natural: Writing is a great enterprise for governing the state and a grand undertaking that never decays

meaning.en: Literature is of great value to the nation and can last forever.
meaning.zh: 文章是治国的大事业，也是流传不朽的盛事，强调文学的重要价值。

equivalents: the pen is mightier than the sword

examples.zh: 作家协会的会议上引用了“盖文章，经国之大业，不朽之盛事”。
examples.en: The writers' association meeting quoted this line.

examples.zh: 他把“盖文章，经国之大业，不朽之盛事”当作写作的信条。
examples.en: He holds this line as his creed in writing.

story.en: Cao Pi's Discourse on Literature (Dianlun) is an early work of literary criticism; he argues that unlike fame and wealth, writing endures.
story.zh: 曹丕《典论·论文》是早期文学批评名篇，提出文章远比荣乐更能流传后世。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 唧唧复唧唧，木兰当户织
pinyin: jī jī fù jī jī, mù lán dāng hù zhī
literal: chirp · chirp · again · chirp · chirp, Mulan · facing · door · weave
natural: Click-clack, click-clack again, Mulan weaves facing the door

meaning.en: The famous opening of the Ballad of Mulan, with a young woman at her loom.
meaning.zh: 《木兰诗》开篇名句，写木兰当户织布的场景。

equivalents: the opening of the Ballad of Mulan

examples.zh: “唧唧复唧唧，木兰当户织”，一开头就把我们带进了故事。
examples.en: This opening takes us straight into the story.

examples.zh: 孩子们能背诵“唧唧复唧唧，木兰当户织”。
examples.en: The children can recite this opening.

story.en: From the Ballad of Mulan, a folk ballad from the Northern Dynasties about a girl who takes her father's place in the army.
story.zh: 出自北朝民歌《木兰诗》，写木兰替父从军的故事。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离。双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌
pinyin: xióng tù jiǎo pū shuò, cí tù yǎn mí lí, shuāng tù bàng dì zǒu, ān néng biàn wǒ shì xióng cí
literal: male · hare · feet · kick · scuffle, female · hare · eyes · blurry · squint, two · hares · side by side · ground · run, how · can · tell · I · am · male · female
natural: The male hare's feet kick about, the female hare's eyes blink; when the two run side by side, who can tell which is which

meaning.en: When two things move together it is hard to tell them apart; used jokingly for hard-to-distinguish situations.
meaning.zh: 两只兔子并排奔跑难辨雌雄，比喻两者不易区分，常用于幽默场合。

equivalents: hard to tell apart when they run together

examples.zh: 双胞胎站在一起，老师笑称“雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离。双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌”。
examples.en: The twins stood together, and the teacher joked this line.

examples.zh: 这首《木兰诗》的“雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离。双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌”幽默地结束了故事。
examples.en: The ballad ends humorously with this line.

story.en: The closing couplets: after twelve years in the army Mulan returns as a woman, and her comrades are astonished; the poem ends with this witty analogy.
story.zh: 《木兰诗》结尾：木兰从军十二年归来，同伴惊讶她是女子，诗以兔喻作结，诙谐有趣。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 万里赴戎机，关山度若飞。朔气传金柝，寒光照铁衣
pinyin: wàn lǐ fù róng jī, guān shān dù ruò fēi, shuò qì chuán jīn tuò, hán guāng zhào tiě yī
literal: ten thousand · li · go to · battle, passes · hills · cross · like · flying, northern · air · carries · metal · watch-clapper, cold · light · shines · iron · armour
natural: She rode ten thousand li to war and crossed passes and hills as if flying; the northern wind carried the sound of the watch-clapper and cold moonlight shone on her armour

meaning.en: Describes the swift, hard march and chilly night watch of a soldier on campaign.
meaning.zh: 描写将士长途行军、翻山越岭和边塞夜晚的艰苦景象。

equivalents: a soldier's long march through the cold

examples.zh: 读到“万里赴戎机，关山度若飞。朔气传金柝，寒光照铁衣”，我仿佛看见木兰策马飞驰。
examples.en: Reading this line I seem to see Mulan galloping on.

examples.zh: 电影解说词里引用了“万里赴戎机，关山度若飞。朔气传金柝，寒光照铁衣”。
examples.en: The film's narration quoted this line.

story.en: From the Ballad of Mulan: describes Mulan's journey and life on the frontier.
story.zh: 出自《木兰诗》：描写木兰奔赴战场及边塞军旅生活。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 将军百战死，壮士十年归
pinyin: jiāng jūn bǎi zhàn sǐ, zhuàng shì shí nián guī
literal: generals · hundred · battles · die, brave · men · ten · years · return
natural: Generals die after hundreds of battles; stout warriors return after ten years

meaning.en: The heavy cost of war: many die and the survivors come home only after long years.
meaning.zh: 写战争的残酷：将军战死，壮士多年之后才得归来。

equivalents: the long toll of war

examples.zh: 读这句“将军百战死，壮士十年归”，能感受到战争的残酷。
examples.en: Reading this line one feels the cruelty of war.

examples.zh: 纪录片结尾引用了“将军百战死，壮士十年归”。
examples.en: The documentary ended by quoting this line.

story.en: From the Ballad of Mulan, summing up her twelve years on campaign.
story.zh: 出自《木兰诗》，概括木兰十二年的征战生涯。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。
